narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives ran exactly the same. In month {fork_month} you chose {real_choice}, and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part, a split in how much of each month was spoken for before it began. In month {layoff_month}, when the layoff came for both of you, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month} the ghost had {net_worth_gap}. Its cushion for a stretch with no pay sat {safety_gap}.
